int_001_030: For verses: prioritize `INT-001..INT-020` with fewer inclusion bursts.
For builds/drops: use `INT-021..INT-030` to merge PAR chase + movers.
Keep inclusion techniques in windows (4-8 bars) so they stay special.
After any high-density inclusion block, insert a simpler 4-bar reset look.
int_031_060: Start with `INT-031..INT-040` for intros, verse grooves, and restrained sections.
Use `INT-041..INT-050` when you need tension without pure chaos.
Reserve `INT-051..INT-060` for build/drop windows and phrase punctuation.
Avoid running inclusion techniques for more than 8 bars without a reset.
int_061_090: Use `INT-061..INT-070` when you need technical polish and strong structure without overloading energy.
Use `INT-071..INT-080` for controlled friction sections where musical tension should rise.
Use `INT-081..INT-090` for drop punctuation, fill handling, and short inclusion windows.
Keep random/shuffle behavior (`INT-076`, `INT-083`) to 1-2 bars before resolving back to deterministic geometry.
After any stack/burst inclusion (`INT-087`, `INT-090`), schedule at least one reset bar with fade-led PAR behavior.

techniques.name: Full Lane Lock
techniques.core_logic: PAR chase direction matches mover route direction exactly.

techniques.name: Downbeat Unison Hit
techniques.core_logic: All fixtures accent beat 1 each bar, then return to base motion.

techniques.name: Phrase Gate Open
techniques.core_logic: First bar of each 8-bar phrase is fully synchronized.

techniques.name: Color World Lock
techniques.core_logic: PAR and mover colors rotate together but positions differ.

techniques.name: Ceiling Lift Together
techniques.core_logic: Both PAR intensity and mover height rise together into phrase peak.

techniques.name: Booth Focus Envelope
techniques.core_logic: Whole rig converges around booth moments for section framing.

techniques.name: Ring March
techniques.core_logic: Circular mover route with matching PAR ring chase.

techniques.name: Fade-to-Chase Sync
techniques.core_logic: PARs fade for 4 bars then switch to chase exactly when movers switch pattern family.

techniques.name: Chorus Stack
techniques.core_logic: Verse uses restrained sync, chorus adds full-fixture alignment.

techniques.name: White Resolve Together
techniques.core_logic: Phrase end: synchronized white resolve then return to color.

techniques.name: Opposing Rails
techniques.core_logic: PAR chase runs L->R while movers run R->L.

techniques.name: In-Out Duel
techniques.core_logic: PARs chase outer->inner while movers route center->edges.

techniques.name: Front-Back Tug
techniques.core_logic: PAR pulse emphasizes downstage while movers oscillate upstage.

techniques.name: Warm-Cool Opposition
techniques.core_logic: PAR warm chase against cool mover beams, swapped every 8 bars.

techniques.name: Beat-Parity Split
techniques.core_logic: PARs own odd beats, movers own even beats.

techniques.name: Diagonal Clash
techniques.core_logic: PAR chase follows one diagonal while movers strike opposite diagonal.

techniques.name: Late Entry Shadow
techniques.core_logic: PAR chase leads by one beat; movers echo one beat late.

techniques.name: Density Offset
techniques.core_logic: Fast PAR chase over sparse mover positions for readable tension.

techniques.name: Height Split
techniques.core_logic: PARs stay floor/wall; movers stay ceiling/high plane.

techniques.name: Polarity Flip
techniques.core_logic: Every 8 bars swap leader/follower roles between PAR and movers.

techniques.name: Chase Leader
techniques.core_logic: Active mover follows the currently lit PAR chase step.
techniques.timing_recipe: movers=4b anchor + 1b leader accents, pars=1b chase

techniques.name: Every-4th-Step Join
techniques.core_logic: Movers join PAR chase on every 4th PAR step only.

techniques.name: Alternating Joiners
techniques.core_logic: Bar A: Sharpy joins PAR chase; Bar B: BSW joins.

techniques.name: Pair Chase + Counter Beams
techniques.core_logic: PAR pairs chase while movers hit opposite pair endpoints.

techniques.name: Ladder Inclusion
techniques.core_logic: Each bar adds one mover into the PAR chase stack.

techniques.name: Expand/Collapse Inclusion
techniques.core_logic: Start with PAR-only chase, expand to full rig, collapse back.

techniques.name: Fill Burst Inclusion
techniques.core_logic: During fills, all movers briefly snap into the running PAR chase.

techniques.name: Phrase-End Catch
techniques.core_logic: End of phrase: movers catch the final PAR chase step and hold.
techniques.timing_recipe: movers=4b with phrase hold, pars=2b chase

techniques.name: Relay Chase
techniques.core_logic: PAR heads pass chase to movers, then movers pass back to PARs.

techniques.name: Ghosted Mover Trace
techniques.core_logic: Movers trace a slower 4-beat “ghost” of a fast PAR chase pattern.

techniques.name: Phase Ladder Lock
techniques.core_logic: Each bar advances mover phase and PAR chase phase together by one step.

techniques.name: Barline Clamp
techniques.core_logic: All fixtures freeze for beat 1, then resume motion for beats 2-4.

techniques.name: Two-Bar Breath
techniques.core_logic: Both fixture families swell and release over 2-bar envelopes.

techniques.name: Beat-4 Sling
techniques.core_logic: Movers pre-position on beat 4 while PARs pre-hit as lead-in.
techniques.timing_recipe: movers=4b with beat4 prep, pars=1b pulse

techniques.name: Phrase Door Open
techniques.core_logic: First bar each 8 bars is full synchronization, then layers split.

techniques.name: Center Spine
techniques.core_logic: One center axis remains common while side fixtures vary.

techniques.name: Color-Step Unison
techniques.core_logic: Color changes only occur when both mover and PAR steps change.

techniques.name: Arc-and-Ring Sync
techniques.core_logic: Movers draw arcs while PARs run ring chase in matching direction.

techniques.name: Lift Stack
techniques.core_logic: Intensity and tilt both rise across 4 bars, then resolve.

techniques.name: Downbeat White Spine
techniques.core_logic: Every bar starts with short shared white punctuation.

techniques.name: Opposite Orbit
techniques.core_logic: Movers orbit clockwise while PAR chase runs counterclockwise.

techniques.name: Hold-vs-Chase
techniques.core_logic: Movers hold 1 bar while PARs chase, then swap roles.

techniques.name: Odd-Even Ownership
techniques.core_logic: PARs own odd beats, movers emphasize even beats.

techniques.name: Slow-Fast Tension
techniques.core_logic: Slow mover route under fast PAR chase, then reverse in breakdown.

techniques.name: Front-Back Pull
techniques.core_logic: PAR intensity pushes downstage while movers pull upstage.

techniques.name: Ceiling-Floor Split
techniques.core_logic: Movers paint high plane while PARs travel low perimeter chase.

techniques.name: Zoom Counterphase
techniques.core_logic: Mover zoom opens as PAR intensity closes, then invert.

techniques.name: Warm-Cool Duel
techniques.core_logic: Warm PAR base versus cool mover accents, swapped every 8 bars.

techniques.name: Diagonal Conflict
techniques.core_logic: PAR diagonal chase counters mover diagonal hit map.

techniques.name: Echo Handoff
techniques.core_logic: PAR pattern leads by 1 beat and movers echo at reduced intensity.

techniques.name: Baton Chase
techniques.core_logic: One mover joins whichever PAR node is currently active.

techniques.name: Pair Relay Join
techniques.core_logic: PAR pair chase passes token to mover pair every 2 beats.
techniques.timing_recipe: movers=4b pair joins, pars=1b pair chase

techniques.name: Every-2 Joiner
techniques.core_logic: Movers enter the PAR chase every second beat only.

techniques.name: Every-4 Joiner
techniques.core_logic: Movers only join on beat 1 each bar for stronger punctuation.

techniques.name: Phrase-End Catch
techniques.core_logic: Movers catch final PAR chase node and hold through transition.

techniques.name: Kick Include
techniques.core_logic: Movers inject short chase joins on kick-heavy windows only.

techniques.name: Snare Include
techniques.core_logic: Movers answer PAR chase on backbeat moments.

techniques.name: Expanding Inclusion Ring
techniques.core_logic: PAR chase starts tight, movers join as radius expands every bar.

techniques.name: Mirror Inclusion Collapse
techniques.core_logic: Full-rig chase mirrors at phrase midpoint then collapses to PAR-only.

techniques.name: Ghost Canopy Trace
techniques.core_logic: Movers run a slow canopy ghost of PAR chase trajectories.

techniques.name: Measure Grid Lock
techniques.core_logic: Both mover and PAR engines restart on shared barline measure points for hard structural clarity.

techniques.name: Winged Mirror Pulse
techniques.core_logic: Movers run winged symmetry while PAR pairs pulse in the same mirrored ownership map.

techniques.name: Delayed Spine Echo
techniques.core_logic: PAR chase forms a center spine and movers echo that spine one beat later.

techniques.name: Block-Step Accord
techniques.core_logic: Fixture blocks step together each bar so movers and PARs change zone in unified chunks.
techniques.timing_recipe: movers=4b block step, pars=1b block chase

techniques.name: Interleave Bloom
techniques.core_logic: Interleaved fixture sets alternate activation but still land on shared phrase accents.

techniques.name: Grid Overlay Match
techniques.core_logic: Vertical mover sweeps and PAR grid overlays advance in the same directional order.
techniques.timing_recipe: movers=4b grid v, pars=1b grid chase

techniques.name: Width Snap Sync
techniques.core_logic: Both layers run narrow width in groove bars, then widen together at phrase markers.

techniques.name: Phase Fan Sweep
techniques.core_logic: Phase fan movement in movers is matched by phase-shift PAR fan chase direction.
techniques.timing_recipe: movers=4b phase fan, pars=1b fan chase

techniques.name: One-Cycle Landing
techniques.core_logic: One complete motion cycle per 8 bars, then both fixture families settle on a shared landing frame.

techniques.name: Rate-Duck Breath
techniques.core_logic: Fast bars are followed by synchronized half-rate bars to protect clarity and groove.

techniques.name: Delay-Phase Drift
techniques.core_logic: Movers drift forward by delay-phase while PAR chase stays quantized on strict beats.

techniques.name: Odd-Even Segment Split
techniques.core_logic: Movers own odd bars and PARs own even bars with shared marker hits at transitions.
techniques.timing_recipe: movers=4b odd bars, pars=1b even bars

techniques.name: Horizontal-Vertical Duel
techniques.core_logic: Movers sweep horizontal planes while PAR chase climbs vertical lanes.

techniques.name: Hold-vs-Ripple
techniques.core_logic: Movers hold geometry while PARs ripple through nodes, then roles invert at phrase midpoint.

techniques.name: Transform Clash
techniques.core_logic: Movers compress while PAR patterns expand, then both swap transform direction.

techniques.name: Shuffle-Vs-Lock
techniques.core_logic: PAR chase order shuffles while mover positions remain locked to a static frame.

techniques.name: Rate Swap Conflict
techniques.core_logic: Movers start slow against fast PARs, then timing ownership swaps every 4 bars.

techniques.name: Width Compression Fight
techniques.core_logic: Mover beam width narrows as PAR chase broadens, creating push-pull visual tension.
techniques.timing_recipe: movers=4b width close, pars=2b width open

techniques.name: Gobo-vs-Color Push
techniques.core_logic: Movers emphasize gobo texture while PARs carry bold color rhythm in opposite phrasing.

techniques.name: Cell-vs-Group Split
techniques.core_logic: Cell-level mover effects run against group-level PAR chase ownership to create layered conflict.
techniques.timing_recipe: movers=4b cell fx, pars=2b group chase

techniques.name: Segmented Baton Include
techniques.core_logic: PAR chase token passes through segments and movers join only on segment boundaries.
techniques.timing_recipe: movers=4b segment joins, pars=1b segmented chase

techniques.name: Ping-Pong Join
techniques.core_logic: PAR ping-pong chase triggers matching mover pair joins at each edge bounce.
techniques.timing_recipe: movers=4b edge joins, pars=1b ping-pong chase

techniques.name: Random Catch Resolve
techniques.core_logic: PAR random chase runs for one bar, then movers catch and force a deterministic resolve shape.

techniques.name: Palette Chase Include
techniques.core_logic: Movers join PAR chase only on accent-color steps while base-color steps stay PAR-only.
techniques.timing_recipe: movers=4b accent joins, pars=1b color-step chase

techniques.name: Wing Relay Join
techniques.core_logic: PAR wing groups relay a chase and movers join whichever wing currently owns the downbeat.
techniques.timing_recipe: movers=4b wing joins, pars=1b wing relay

techniques.name: Measure-End Surge
techniques.core_logic: Movers join in a short surge at each measure end, then drop back to support mode.

techniques.name: Burst-Then-Breathe Include
techniques.core_logic: Two bars of aggressive inclusion are followed by two bars of PAR-only breathing space.

techniques.name: Inverted Downbeat Include
techniques.core_logic: Movers include on downbeats while PAR chase intentionally blanks downbeats for contrast.
techniques.timing_recipe: movers=4b downbeat joins, pars=1b offbeat chase

techniques.name: Center Catch Decay
techniques.core_logic: Movers catch center PAR nodes at phrase end and decay out while PAR chase continues lightly.

techniques.name: Layer Stack Peel
techniques.core_logic: PAR+mover inclusion stacks across 4 bars, then peels back one layer per bar.
